description: Pay for deterministic MusicXML validation and diagnostics against Musicwire's quality bar. Hosted clients receive HTTP 402 with an x402 Exact USDC quote until they retry the identical tools/call with Payment-Signature; stdio auto-pays when MUSICWIRE_X402_PRIVATE_KEY is set. Does not render audio. Reuse idempotency_key when retrying the same document.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse when retrying the same paid request so Musicwire replays the original outcome instead of authorizing another payment.

name: musicwire_validate
title: Validate MusicXML
